title: Tally's status reports count every session and say what each is working on

fields.why: Tally told TJ Nightmare Mode had two sessions; it had six, five working

text: Cause: lib/overview.mjs sessionLines() filters with !o.spawn, so spin-off sessions are dropped from genlock overview, and it prints only state + last message, never the task. Fix: include spawn sessions, name each by its ticket short name, add a count line per project ('6 sessions: 5 working, 1 finished'), check WAITING ON THE USER is current. Tests in tests/run.mjs. Evidence: last turns of ~/.claude/projects/-Users-tj-Library-Application-Support-Genlock-Assistant/a8c34440-250b-4350-8f5a-689e34c8e7d0.jsonl
Spun-off sessions are not a separate kind anywhere the user or Tally sees: overview treats every open session the same, with no 'spinoff' label or separate count
user_said: we shouldnt even see 'spun off sessions' as a thing. they are just real sessions

text: genlock overview lists every open session in a project the same way, with no spin-off distinction, each named by its current task
check: tests/run.mjs: a project with one main and two spawned sessions prints 3 session lines, each with its task short name, and none says spin-off
